Many doors

Six links, no path between them

A woman who finds you through a reel chooses between a circle, a retreat, a course, a call, a community and a podcast. Nothing walks her from one step to the next, so most choose nothing.

Open calendar

Your time goes to whoever books

The 1:1 connection call is pay what you want and open to anyone. You can't tell who is ready for coaching or a retreat until you're already on the call.

Reach

New women arrive when a reel travels

All 7 of your last 7 reels went past 2k views. That reach is real, but there's no system turning it into sign-ups every day, so quiet weeks stay quiet.

The women not ready for 1:1 or a retreat today leave without a next step built for them, and you can't see who is ready.

My recommendation

A free masterclass that becomes the one path through everything you offer

You already have a course, so the class can be free. She's Had Enough becomes the thank-you page offer, and the replay page is where the right women apply for 1:1 coaching or your next retreat. Your community, circles and podcast stay exactly as they are.

Women who are ready to stop shrinking

Here's what you'll learn

Script 1 · "The shoulds"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Most women can list ten things they should be. Very few can say who they actually are."

Body

"Be nicer. Be smaller. Be busier. Be everything for everyone. We learn the 'shoulds' so young we stop noticing them. The beautiful part is that anything learned can be gently unlearned."

CTA

"I'm sharing how in a free 60-minute live masterclass, Divine As You Are. The replay is included. Tap Sign up to save your seat."

Shot: talking to camera outdoors at golden hour, red top, warm light.

Script 2 · "The sacred pause"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Rest isn't a reward for finishing everything. Here's why."

Body

"So many women only stop when there's nothing left to give. A sacred pause is different: a few minutes, on purpose, to slow down and listen to what you actually want. It's the first practice I teach every woman I work with."

CTA

"I'll guide you through it live in my free masterclass. Tap Sign up."

Shot: candle lit, Liv sits down, breathes, talks to camera. On-screen text "the sacred pause".

Script 3 · "Why women gather"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Something happens when women sit in a circle together."

Body

"Someone says the thing you've never said out loud, and suddenly you're not the only one. I've held circles and retreats for women for years, and that moment never gets old. My free masterclass brings a little of that feeling online."

CTA

"Come as you are. Seats are free. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: talking to camera, cut to candles, flowers and an empty circle of cushions (no other faces).

Every ad points to the free masterclass, makes no promise of outcomes and carries "Educational content, not medical advice." in the caption.
